\sphinxAtStartPar
ECP5 design: an AXI4\sphinxhyphen{}Stream threshold filter with an AXI4\sphinxhyphen{}Lite register file.

\sphinxAtStartPar
Bytes arriving on s\_axis are forwarded to m\_axis if they are at or above a
threshold the bus master sets through the registers.
